name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-prototype-styled-ducking
title: Super Mario World (Prototype) Styled Ducking
description:
Sprites based of the ducking sprites seen in the 2020 giga leak. (Note: this does NOT come with any ducking sprites for Small Mario.)

Comes with two versions, WIDE ducking and one similar to the one seen in Super Mario Bros 3.

This need the 32x32 player patch to work.
